I'm a little loath to call this a recipe, but it's so delicious and healthy that it must be shared on the off chance that you've never heard of this trick :)

Ingredients

A bag of grapes
A ziploc bag
A freezer

Preparation

  1. Wash your grapes and pat them dry so they don't clump together in the freezer.
  2. Put your grapes in the ziploc bag to prevent that awkward freezer taste from infiltrating, and freeze for at least 4 hours
  3. Grab a few whenever you're feeling hungry and enjoy!

From my experience, frozen grapes can last up to around 3-4 weeks without any loss of flavor, but they never last that long.
Frozen Grapes: Trivially easy, obsenely delicious
